nodes.label: Decided lucene arm: bm25s `method="lucene"` — the Lucene / Elasticsearch BM25 variant (bm25s's default; k1=0.9 / b=0.4 are the BEIR reference values). It reproduces Lucene's scoring exactly; the analysis (EN stopwords + Snowball/Porter2 stem) is Lucene-like, not Lucene's Java analyzer.
